title: [Master Data Management] Cleanup when copying environment
summary: Master Data Management now performs cleanup when an environment is copied, via changes to its subscribers, HTTP source transport and setup table. The description rates the risk as low because live tenants do not use the feature yet.
key_points: Cleanup runs when an environment gets copied
Touches Master Data Mgt. Subscribers, MDM Http Source Transport and Master Data Management Setup
New automated tests added for cross-environment consumer scenarios
Low risk per author since the feature is not yet used by live tenants
quote: We should do cleanup before environment gets copied
